title: Specified scalar and common-object normalization of smooth coefficient operations
statement: Under the hypotheses and with the finite operation models of [def-pur-smooth-operation-coefficient-models], define the strict coefficient comparison for $H_E=Lf_E^*(-)(d)[2d]$ by the actual pullback/twist/shift comparison and for $G_E=Rf_E^!$ by the specified counit mate of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image, lem-pur-rational-scalar-comparison-identification], retaining the stage-to-tensor maps at both endpoints. Define the common-object normalization $H(E,K)\cong(E,H_EK)$ by its completeness self-extension and tensor unitors and $G(E,K)\cong(E,G_EK)$ by the inverse exceptional common coefficient comparison. These are maps of the actual operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-coefficient-twists-detailed].
